title: Precious Metals Trader (Analyst, Associate or VP)
full_description:
London, United Kingdom
Department Overview:The Commodity Trading desk is providing commodity hedges and risk management solutions. The main clients are corporates with hedging needs in the commodity space. The desk has a global presence with teams in New York, Singapore and London. The desk covers a wide product range, covering Energy, Base and Precious Metals
